# synomosai-theory-stance-en

> English-facing theory-stance document of SynomosAI's four-pillar Human-AI Governance: AI Passport Regime, XCGS Governance System, A³ Law, and AI-world Coinhabitation. Includes a self-contained panorama HTML.

A content-only repo (Markdown + static HTML). It states the theoretical stance for international readers and English LLM indexing; it runs no checks.

## Core

- [gov_four-pillars_en_v0.1-theory-stance.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-theory-stance-en/blob/main/gov_four-pillars_en_v0.1-theory-stance.md): four-pillar theory stance (English, v0.1)
- [gov_panorama_en_v0.1-theory-stance.html](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-theory-stance-en/blob/main/gov_panorama_en_v0.1-theory-stance.html): interactive panorama
- [README.md](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-theory-stance-en/blob/main/README.md): bilingual overview
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/SynomosAI/synomosai-theory-stance-en/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
